title: "Learn"

Theory, explanations, and reference notes — organised by subject. This is where
concepts are explained; worked examples, exercises and quizzes live under
[Practise](../practise/index.qmd) instead.

- [Statistics](statistics/index.qmd) — probability, inference, regression, and modelling.
- [Machine Learning](machine-learning/index.qmd) — supervised and unsupervised methods, model evaluation.
- [Mathematics](mathematics/index.qmd) — the mathematical foundations behind the above.
- [Data Science](data-science/index.qmd) — data wrangling, exploration, and reproducible workflows.
- [Experimental Design](experimental-design/index.qmd) — designing and analysing experiments.
- [Ecology](ecology/index.qmd) — how organisms interact with one another and with their environment, from populations to ecosystems.
- [Programming & Computing](programming-computing/index.qmd) — R, Python, SQL, Git, and the command line.
